info.name: Smart Cafe DT2-3 Personal Account
info.description: Run only with generated synthetic credentials on a dedicated verified MySQL *_test schema. See scripts/profile-postman-live.py. The runner revokes staff2 and deactivates the dedicated account after Login. expiryBaseUrl is the same JAR with a one-second bearer TTL. No tokens are forged.
